    show-config         Print effective configuration as JSON
    authorize-live-session
                        Authorize automatic live orders for one NASDAQ regular
                        session
    revoke-live-session
                        Revoke the stored automatic live-session authorization
    select-symbols      Preview learned symbol selection without constructing
                        orders
    gui                 Launch the desktop management app
    backtest            Run a CSV historical backtest
    once                Run one live decision cycle
    loop                Repeat decision cycles on an interval
    buying-power        Check KIS overseas buying power without submitting an
                        order
    day-test            Plan a one-share same-day KIS buy/sell test
    sell-monitor        Monitor and sell the existing HIVE 1-share position
                        only
    live-canary-preflight
                        Run trading-API GET-only checks; OAuth token POST may
                        occur
    live-canary-arm     Issue a one-market-date authorization for the bounded
                        live canary
    live-canary         Run the unattended bounded KIS live canary role
    trading-agents      Run optional TradingAgents analysis without submitting
                        orders
